## Original article text

````markdown
## Description

Restarts the action list from the beginning if at least one condition in the condition list is false. If all conditions are true, execution continues with the next action. To prevent an infinite loop, a [Wait](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/wait) action must execute between the start of the action list and this action.
````
